title: Handling of NAS signalling low priority indication

entities.name: Device properties IE
entities.description: Information Element used by UE to indicate NAS signalling low priority configuration. Contains a low priority indicator field.

entities.name: Low priority indicator
entities.description: Field within Device properties IE that indicates whether MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority or not.

entities.name: UE performing attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

entities.name: UE has PDN connection for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority' during EPS mobility management or PDN connection establishment.

entities.name: Dual priority UE requested for non-low priority PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where UE configured for dual priority sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority' when upper layers request PDN connection without low priority.

entities.name: UE performing service request for CS fallback emergency call
entities.description: Condition where UE sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

entities.name: UE configured to use AC11-15 in selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

entities.name: UE responding to paging
entities.description: Condition where UE sets low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message that may contain NAS signalling low priority indication in Device properties IE.

entities.name: Stored NAS signalling low priority indication
entities.description: NAS signalling low priority indication stored by MME within default EPS bearer context after PDN connectivity request procedure.

entities.name: NAS level mobility management congestion control
entities.description: Network procedure that may use NAS signalling low priority indication for congestion control.

relations.description: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message may contain Device properties IE with low priority indication.
Device properties IE contains low priority indicator field.
Emergency attach condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
Emergency PDN connection condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
Dual priority request condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
CS fallback emergency condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
AC11-15 usage condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
Paging response condition forces low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with low priority indication causes MME to store this indication in default EPS bearer context.
Network uses NAS signalling low priority indication for congestion control procedures.
